narrative: Builders shipped more Spaces this week than last (7,134, +3.1%), while new model uploads ran the other way (25,742, −4.5%). Conversational assistants remain the largest named thing people build (1,018 of 7,134), with image generation, data analysis, document AI and search behind it. The clearest movement is in who the work points at: scientific research gained ground as a target vertical (+1.3 points), and multimodal and fine-tuned approaches each picked up share while tool use and vision-language gave some back. A residual bucket of 2,043 unclassified-by-purpose Spaces still outweighs every named use case, so the mix should be read with that in mind.
